deadline.value: Full consideration for MS and PhD fall admission is January 1. The page gives no year, so the year is inferred.
deadline.quote: Master of Science and Ph.D. Program Deadlines

gre_general.value: The department no longer requires the GRE for admission.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is no longer required by our department for admissions.

gre_subject.value: No GRE, including a subject test, is required.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE is no longer required by our department for admissions.

supervisor.value: A faculty advisor does not need to be secured before applying, though identifying faculty is helpful.
supervisor.quote: It is not required that applicants have secured a faculty advisor prior to submitting their application materials.

funding.value: The department describes its MS and PhD research programmes as fully funded via GTA or GRA positions.
funding.quote: Students will work either as graduate teaching assistants or as graduate research assistants in these fully funded programs.

entry_route.value: The page does not state the degree needed before a PhD.

notes: Department says it cannot provide application fee waivers beyond the Graduate School's; the English rules are set by the Graduate School.
